parts:

I am glad that Shiny introduced HTML Templates, which really helps us to improve all of our dashboard feel and look by using ready-to-use bootstrap template. 

One issue we are facing now it some of outputs won't show 

{{ dygraphOutput("test") }}
{{ DT::dataTableOutput("test2") }}

Has anyone used this and been successful?

Any thoughts?

Thank you in advance,
Jeremy

messages.subject: Re: HTML Templates
parts:
You're loading jQuery twice. Shiny itself loads one copy, you're loading a second copy (under the comment "Mainly scripts"), which breaks the first copy. If you remove that it should work.

If you actually need jQuery 2.x (we bundle 1.x with Shiny) let me know and I can show you how to have your version replace ours.

On Wed, Apr 13, 2016 at 8:46 AM Joe Cheng <j...@rstudio.com> wrote:
Hmmm, that should work. Do you mind sending a minimal reproducible example?
